changelog:
- Initial release of composer-optimizer skill.
- Scores and filters Composer TRADITIONAL_IRA strategies using mean-variance optimization.
- Automatically zeroes out weak or redundant strategies (no forced cuts).
- Outputs optimized result to trading_bot/composer_optimized_trad_ira.json.
summary: Performs mean-variance optimization on Traditional IRA strategies, eliminating weak ones and outputting optimized portfolio weights without forced exclusions.
